methodological_rigor.justification: Appropriate methodology for study type with adequate sample size or replication. Standard statistical approaches applied with effect estimates and confidence intervals. Some limitations in sensitivity analyses or confounding variable adjustment noted. Overall methodologically sound without major flaws.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Study type classified as basic science. Results address clinically relevant question with plausible translational implications. Limited direct clinical applicability.

reporting_quality.justification: Adherence to ARRIVE reporting standards adequate. Methods described with sufficient detail for reproducibility. Key sections present but some gaps noted. Data availability not prominently featured.

novelty_literature.justification: Meaningful contribution to field addressing documented questions. Extensions of prior work or novel applications. Incremental advances without being purely confirmatory.

writing_presentation.justification: Writing clear and appropriately organized. Main findings effectively communicated. Figures and tables support narrative. Publication-ready quality.

key_strengths: Adequate sample size or replication with appropriate controls
Clear presentation of findings and logical organization
key_concerns: Limited novelty or routine application of established methods
Data availability and reproducibility information limited
chief_reviewer.rationale: Competent preclinical study addressing relevant questions. Appropriate for Tier 4 journal.
